primary.active_substep: Establish the PPIA-08 source/design foundation and authority boundaries. Start from MV-IA-F005 Campaign, Scene, and Session Builder plus the existing battle-map, Scene Builder, encounter, World/Setting, Item, Creature/NPC, Vehicle, Species, permission, recovery and accessibility contracts. Incorporate the owner-directed map authoring expansion as a blocking capability: GM uploads a map image; calibrates a grid by scale/cell size and pan/offset alignment; locks or revises calibration with versioned recovery; addresses individual grid cells/areas; assigns governed items, hazards, encounters, creatures/NPCs, vehicles, objectives, triggers, notes and other Scene placements to cells/areas without mutating source Definitions; and can create a basic dungeon map using rooms, corridors, walls, doors, terrain/features and simple reusable tiles/stamps. Preserve gridless operation and required nonvisual map/scene equivalents.
primary.next_action: Create and validate the PPIA-08 source/design foundation. Inventory governing Campaign/Scene/Session, map, encounter, object-placement, permissions, recovery and accessibility sources; define the semantic taxonomy and presentation profiles; specify uploaded-map/media ownership, grid calibration transforms, cell/area addressing, placement references, gridless mode, dungeon-construction primitives, hidden/reveal layers, launch-snapshot behavior and cross-domain boundaries. The foundation must make map-grid calibration and dungeon construction blocking PPIA-08 requirements without prematurely implementing tactical combat resolution, advanced dynamic lighting/fog simulation, Encounter Builder balance logic or application runtime.
